review_candidates.title: Senior Cost Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Cost Engineer We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Cost Engineer to join our project controls team. In this key role, you will be responsible for cost management, budget forecasting, variance analysis, and change control for complex, mega-scale rail and high-capacity transit infrastructure programs. You will work closely with project managers, estimators, and schedulers to ensure strict financial control and data integrity across multi-billion-dollar capital projects. This is a full-time position based in Sacramento, CA . LOCATION: Sacramento, CA (Remote within California) TYPE: Full-time INDUSTRY: Rail / Transportation / Megaprojects AREA OF SPECIALTY: Project Controls / Cost Engineering / Rail and Heavy Civil Projects What You'll Do As our Senior Cost Engineer, you will drive the cost management lifecycle across complex rail infrastructure contracts. Your responsibilities will include: Cost Management & Control: Establish, maintain, and monitor project cost baselines, commitments, actual expenditures, and forecasts across all project phases, from design through construction and commissioning. Earned Value Management (EVM): Implement and oversee Earned Value Management systems to measure project performance, track Cost Performance Index (CPI) and Schedule Performance Index (SPI), and highlight trends or variances. Budget Forecasting & Trend Analysis: Conduct regular financial forecasting, cash flow modeling, and cost-to-complete analyses. Identify negative trends early and recommend actionable corrective strategies to project leadership. Change Order Management: Evaluate, review, and negotiate contractor scope changes, change orders, and potential claims. Assess cost impacts against approved baselines and maintain the change management log. Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Alignment: Ensure all project expenditures, purchase orders, and contractor pay applications are accurately coded and tracked against the standardized program WBS and Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS). Financial Reporting: Prepare comprehensive monthly and quarterly cost management reports, executive dashboards, and variance summaries for internal leadership, program directors, and agency stakeholders. Contract & Invoice Auditing: Review and audit contractor billing applications, progress pay estimates, and subcontractor invoices for accuracy, contract compliance, and alignment with physically verified work progress. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work side-by-side with senior estimators, risk managers, and schedulers to perform quantitative cost-risk analysis, contingency management, and baseline reconciliation. What You'll Bring We are seeking a detail-oriented professional with deep expertise in heavy civil cost engineering and mega-project financial controls. Required Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Quantity Surveying, or a related technical discipline. Experience: A minimum of 7-10 years of progressive cost engineering and project controls experience on major infrastructure programs, with extensive focus on large-scale rail, transit, or heavy civil construction projects. Cost & EVM Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency with industry-standard cost control, project management, and ERP software (e.g., Primavera Unifier, EcoSys, PRISM Cost Management, SAP, or Oracle Financials). Technical Engineering Acumen: Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, contract specifications, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and construction sequencing to validate cost allocation and progress billing. Analytical & Financial Modeling: Advanced capabilities in financial modeling, quantitative risk analysis, and complex data manipulation using MS Excel. Communication & Stakeholder Interface: Superior written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to present complex cost analyses clearly to project executives and client teams. Proactive Problem Solving: A self-starter mindset focused on accuracy, data integrity, and early variance detection to protect project budgets. Preferred Qualifications: Professional certification in cost engineering or project management (e.g., AACE International Certified Cost Professional (CCP), Earned Value Professional (EVP), or PMI Project Management Professional (PMP)). Deep technical familiarity with rail systems, trackwork, bridge/viaduct structures, utility relocations, and heavy civil construction methodologies.

review_candidates.title: Senior Associate, Private Credit
review_candidates.description: About Tempus Gate Tempus Gate is an independent private credit platform focused on connecting established mid-sized companies in Türkiye with institutional capital from Europe and the region. We focus on structuring and arranging mezzanine and senior secured financing. Our two co-founders bring complementary backgrounds. One has a background in technology and strategy. The other is a recognised figure in the private credit industry with nearly 20 years of experience. The role We are looking for a Senior Associate to lead deal execution in Türkiye. You will work directly with the private credit co-founder, who leads origination and manages relationships with capital providers. You will take transactions from initial screening through due diligence, structuring and closing. Typical transactions include balance sheet refinancings, dividend recapitalisations, acquisition financings, shareholder buyouts and management buyouts, with ticket sizes of USD 20–50 million. Our pipeline exceeds USD 120 million, and we expect to close two to three transactions over the next 12 months. What you’ll do Screen inbound opportunities and recommend which transactions to pursue. Normalise historical financials and build transaction models covering the three financial statements, working capital, debt schedules, sensitivities and downside scenarios. Write concise screening memos in English and prepare first drafts of indicative term sheets. Prepare investor materials and reconcile them with the underlying financial models. Manage information requests and management Q&A, and coordinate with lawyers, auditors and other advisers. Use AI tools where they improve the workflow and verify the accuracy of everything you deliver. What we’re looking for 4–6 years of experience in corporate finance, M&A or debt advisory, transaction services, or acquisition and structured finance at a bank. Hands-on experience building financial models for live transactions and preparing credit committee papers or information memoranda. Ability to interpret Turkish financial statements, including the effects of IAS 29 and foreign exchange exposure. Fluency in Turkish and English, with clear and concise writing skills. Sound credit judgement and the ability to challenge management assumptions when the numbers point to a different conclusion. Why join Tempus Gate You’ll work directly with the private credit co-founder at every stage of a transaction and help shape our investment processes and documentation standards. You’ll take responsibility for the quality of deal execution, with support from external specialists. Location The role is remote within Türkiye, with occasional in-person meetings with companies, advisers and partners.

review_candidates.title: Secundair Engineer | Hoogspanning | Elektrotechniek | Energietechniek
review_candidates.description: Van beveiligingssystemen tot complete secundaire installaties: werk aan de techniek achter hoogspanningsstations van 110 tot 380 kV. Welkom bij Akkodis Als Secundair Engineer bij Akkodis in Zaltbommel werk je vanuit onze interne projectafdeling aan de engineering van hoogspanningsstations. Van nieuwbouw en uitbreiding tot renovatie van bestaande installaties. Zo zijn we onder andere betrokken bij een groot, meerjarig hoogspanningsproject, maar werken we ook aan kleinere projecten van enkele maanden. De engineering verzorgen we volledig in eigen huis, samen met een hecht team van engineers en tekenaars. Je ontwerpt secundaire installaties voor de beveiliging, besturing en communicatie van hoogspanningsstations. Denk aan beveiligings- en besturingssystemen, interfacekasten, kabelvoorzieningen en telecom- en SCADA-oplossingen. Afhankelijk van het project kun je ook werken aan tertiaire installaties, zoals hulp- en noodstroomvoorzieningen. Je vertaalt technische eisen naar ontwerpen, werkt berekeningen uit en begeleidt tekenaars bij de verdere uitwerking in Elcad. Je wordt onderdeel van ons multidisciplinaire engineeringteam in Zaltbommel en werkt voor de hoogspanningsprojecten nauw samen met onze collega's in Enter. Zo draag je bij aan de verdere groei van onze hoogspanningsactiviteiten in Zaltbommel, terwijl je kunt terugvallen op de kennis en ervaring van een gespecialiseerd engineeringteam. Op kantoor werken collega's die net gestart zijn naast engineers die al tientallen jaren bij Akkodis werken. De sfeer is nuchter, de lijnen zijn kort en je kent de mensen met wie je samenwerkt. Tegelijkertijd maak je deel uit van een internationale engineeringorganisatie, met kennis en expertise vanuit allerlei technische disciplines. Ons engineeringteam is gevestigd in Zaltbommel, maar in overleg zijn er ook mogelijkheden om vanuit een van onze andere vestigingen, hybride of remote te werken. Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit als Secundair Engineer? Vertalen van klanteisen naar technische ontwerpen Engineeren van secundaire installaties Uitwerken van beveiligings- en besturingssystemen Ontwerpen van schakel- en interfacekasten Berekenen en uitwerken van kabelvoorzieningen Begeleiden van tekenaars bij de 2D-uitwerking Opstellen en controleren van ontwerpdocumentatie Toetsen van ontwerpen aan normen en projecteisen Wat je daarnaast oppakt als je je rol graag verbreedt: Projectlocaties bezoeken voor technische opnames Junior engineers en tekenaars begeleiden Kennis delen met collega's binnen het team Bijdragen aan standaardisatie en verbeteringen Een goede match Je hebt ervaring met secundaire engineering en vindt het prettig om zelfstandig aan je ontwerpen te werken, zonder er alleen voor te staan. Je overlegt makkelijk met collega's wanneer een technisch vraagstuk daarom vraagt en vindt het interessant om ook mee te kijken naar wat er binnen andere disciplines speelt. Je houdt van een nuchtere werkomgeving waarin je gewoon bij elkaar binnenloopt om inzichten en ideeën te delen. Hoe word jij succesvol als Secundair Engineer? Achtergrond in Elektrotechniek, Energietechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar Ervaring met engineeren van secundaire installaties Kennis van beveiligings- en besturingssystemen Bekend met Elcad, Eplan of vergelijkbare software Vaardig in uitwerken en beoordelen van ontwerpen Nog geen ervaring met Elcad of Eplan, maar wel met vergelijkbare software? Dan helpen we je om snel vertrouwd te raken met onze werkwijze. Jij staat centraal Iedere engineer heeft eigen ambities. Daarom krijg je bij Akkodis de ruimte om je te ontwikkelen op een manier die bij jou past. Wil je je verder specialiseren in secundaire techniek, doorgroeien naar Lead Engineer of Projectleider, of juist eens ontdekken wat er buiten de hoogspanning mogelijk is? Binnen onze internationale engineeringorganisatie zijn er volop mogelijkheden om je kennis te verdiepen of je horizon te verbreden. Welke richting je ook kiest, je kunt rekenen op collega's die hun kennis graag delen en met je meedenken over je volgende stap. Stap jij aan boord? Salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, met ruimte voor verdere groei en aanvullende bonusregelingen Een vast contract vanaf je eerste werkdag Kies of je 32, 36 of 40 uur werkt, zodat het bij jou past Comfortabel op pad met een leaseauto of vergoeding Flexibele werktijden en mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken Tot wel 36 vakantiedagen om tot rust te komen Toegang tot bedrijfsfitness, fietsplan en gratis fruit Gunstige pensioenregeling voor later Teamuitjes en gave events om te connecten Trainingen, cursussen, coaching en kennissessies Persoonlijk Ontwikkelplan gericht op jouw groei Doorgroeien naar Expert, Lead Engineer of Projectleider: jij bepaalt jouw carrièrepad! Wil jij werken aan uiteenlopende hoogspanningsprojecten, met de sfeer van een hecht engineeringteam en de mogelijkheden van een internationale organisatie? Solliciteer direct of plan een digitale bak koffie in: app Isabel Sukurica (Talent Acquisition Lead) via 06 1376 1115 of mail naar isabel.sukurica@akkodis.com . Ook als je benieuwd bent naar de mogelijkheden als Senior of Lead Secundair Engineer, of liever vanuit Nijmegen, Rotterdam of Enter werkt.

review_candidates.title: Project Manager II (OCONUS)
review_candidates.description: Global Dimensions is seeking an experienced Project Manager II (OCONUS) to support a U.S. Department of State GLOBALCAP task order providing pre-deployment training for military units from N'Djamena, Chad preparing for the Haiti Gang Suppression Force mission . The successful candidate will oversee day-to-day in-country program execution, training coordination, personnel management, logistics, equipment accountability, and operational reporting. This position requires extensive military leadership experience, familiarity with Sub-Saharan African operational environments, and the ability to coordinate effectively with U.S. Government representatives, host-nation officials, and CONUS program management. Employment is contingent upon task-order award and final Government requirements. Essential Job Functions: Direct day-to-day in-country program execution and serve as the primary country-level point of contact for the CONUS Program Manager. Supervise and ensure quality assurance of training activities, mentorship programs, supplies, equipment deliveries, joint inventories, and equipment handovers . Lead and support in-country personnel , ensuring effective coordination of operational activities and mission requirements. Oversee security, safety, transportation, lodging, life support, and administrative arrangements necessary to support successful program execution. Coordinate with the U.S. Embassy, PM/SA, host-nation officials, and CONUS program management to maintain effective communication and operational alignment. Promptly report incidents, significant operational changes, and issues affecting program performance to appropriate stakeholders. Manage training schedules, local coordination activities, and reporting requirements to support concurrent country operations. Ensure effective coordination among training personnel, government representatives, host-nation counterparts, and operational support teams . Required Skills: Due to the sensitivity of customer-related requirements, U.S. citizenship is required . Candidates must meet one of the following education and project management experience requirements: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a minimum of five (5) years of relevant project management experience; OR High school diploma (or equivalent) and a minimum of nine (9) years of relevant project management experience; OR Master's degree (or equivalent) and a minimum of three (3) years of relevant project management experience. Minimum of 15 years of military experience , including military service after September 11, 2001 . Must have attained a military grade of Chief Warrant Officer 3 (CW-3), Enlisted Grade E9, Major (O4), or higher . Demonstrated experience serving as a senior military or civilian mentor/advisor to senior foreign security counterparts . Relevant experience within the past five (5) years in military operations, foreign security force operations (police or military), or program management. Demonstrated operational or professional experience in Sub-Saharan Africa . Demonstrated fluency in English , including strong written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to manage in-country personnel, training operations, logistics, operational schedules, and competing mission priorities . Strong leadership, organizational, problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination skills. Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and ensure successful execution of mission-critical program requirements. Desired Skills: Experience supporting organizational development, institutional capacity building, or institutional improvement initiatives . Training or certification as a Foreign Area Officer (FAO) with relevant regional experience, including assignments with a Military Group (MILGRP) or Defense Attaché Office . Previous battalion- or brigade-level staff experience supporting combat operations, peacekeeping missions, or contingency deployments. Prior military, advisory, or program management experience in Chad. Experience supporting U.S. or NATO military training programs, doctrine development, or military training-school assignments . Fluency in French . Additional Information: This position is based outside the continental United States (OCONUS) in N'Djamena, Chad and requires direct oversight of in-country program operations and coordination with CONUS program management. The anticipated start date is February 1, 2027 .

review_candidates.description: Summary This position offers an exciting opportunity to join an innovative ARPA-H-funded 1-CURE research program focused on developing a novel, low-cost, and broadly accessible treatment platform for glioblastoma. The Postdoctoral Associate will lead preclinical in vivo studies using intracranial glioblastoma models, performing stereotactic tumor implantation procedures, monitoring treatment response, collecting biological specimens, and conducting downstream immunologic, genomic, and histopathologic analyses. Working within a highly collaborative translational research environment, the individual will partner with imaging and chemistry core teams, analyze complex datasets, contribute to study design, and disseminate findings through scientific publications and presentations. This role is ideal for a highly motivated scientist with expertise in neuro-oncology, tumor immunology, and rodent surgical models who is passionate about advancing innovative cancer therapies toward clinical translation. Baylor College of Medicine typically follows similar to the NIH stipulated stipend guidelines for Postdoctoral Associates. Job Duties Design, develop, and execute preclinical research studies focused on evaluating novel therapeutic approaches for glioblastoma using orthotopic and genetically engineered mouse models. Develop experimental protocols, study timelines, animal utilization plans, and outcome measures aligned with project milestones and sponsor objectives. Interpret experimental findings, identify technical challenges, and implement solutions to ensure successful completion of research objectives. Maintains detailed records, protocols, and documentation to ensure research reproducibility, data integrity, and regulatory compliance. Establish and manage intracranial glioblastoma models using stereotactic implantation techniques and other relevant tumor induction methods. Perform specialized rodent procedures including tumor implantation, treatment administration, blood collection, imaging preparation, neurological assessments, tissue collection, and necropsy. Monitor animals for tumor progression, treatment response, neurological signs, body weight changes, and humane endpoints in accordance with approved IACUC protocols. Collect, process, and preserve blood, tumor, brain, and peripheral tissues for downstream molecular, immunologic, histopathologic, and genomic analyses. Perform and oversee laboratory assays including flow cytometry, cytokine profiling, immune cell characterization, tissue processing, immunohistochemistry, molecular biology techniques, and biomarker analyses. Collaborate with imaging, pathology, genomics, and bioinformatics core facilities to evaluate treatment efficacy and biological mechanisms. Analyze data generated from multimodal research platforms, including imaging, histopathology, immune profiling, gene expression, and sequencing studies. Contribute to preparation of manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and present findings at scientific conferences and professional meetings. Perform other job-related duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications MD or Ph.D. in Basic Science, Health Science, or a related field. No experience required. Preferred Qualifications Ph.D. in Neuroscience, Cancer Biology, Molecular Biology, Immunology, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacology, Neuro-Oncology, Veterinary Sciences, or a closely related field. Postdoctoral training with a focus on neuro-oncology, brain tumor biology, tumor immunology, or translational cancer research preferred. 3-5 years of hands-on experience conducting preclinical cancer research, including extensive experience with rodent models. Demonstrated expertise in establishing and managing intracranial glioblastoma models, including stereotactic surgical implantation techniques. Experience with genetically engineered mouse models, syngeneic tumor models, and other preclinical platforms used to study glioblastoma and therapeutic response. Experience working in multidisciplinary, federally funded, collaborative research programs. Strong publication record demonstrating scientific productivity and the ability to communicate research findings effectively. Expertise in rodent neurosurgical procedures, stereotactic surgery, intracranial tumor implantation, animal monitoring, and tissue collection techniques. Experience with flow cytometry, immune profiling, cytokine analysis, molecular biology methods, tissue processing, histopathology, and immunohistochemistry. Experience using research software such as GraphPad Prism, FlowJo, R, Python, or equivalent analytical platforms. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple studies, prioritize competing deadlines, and maintain detailed research documentation. Excellent written and oral communication skills, including preparation of scientific manuscripts, grant applications, technical reports, and presentations.
